utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely, and folks are still dropping off tools and spare parts. I can check what’s still needed if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s really still happening, then? If you check, could you tell me what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I’m planning to spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. When and where is it again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s happening this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 2. I’ll make sure everyone gets the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — we could really use tools, gloves, and any spare screws or nails you’ve got. If you can swing by the hardware store, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do that. I’ll bring tools, gloves, and whatever screws or nails I can grab from the store.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — first we need to sort the supplies and see what’s missing. If you can help inventory the tools, I’ll make a list of what to gather next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll check the tools and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time does the repair drive start, and does it overlap with school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure yet, but I can find out and let you know right away. I’ll make sure it doesn’t clash with pickup if I can help it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. If you can send me the time as soon as you know, I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Oren. Just tell me the plan for the repair drive, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli — I’m still putting the pieces together, but I’ll get you the plan as soon as I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, Oren — just let me know when it’s ready, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m glad you’re here — there’s a repair drive coming up, and I think you’d be great to have involved. Want me to send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send them — I just need to check the timing and where people are meeting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the timing and meeting spot right over. If you want, I can also include what kinds of repairs we’re tackling.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening—do you know what they’re collecting and where I should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — they’re collecting small appliances, hand tools, and any spare parts that can be reused. You can drop everything off at the community center front steps on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll bring what I’ve got to the community center front steps Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help, but I want to check the details first—what’s the repair drive for, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s for helping folks fix small household and bike repairs around the block, and we’re aiming for Saturday morning at the community center. If you can, I’d love for you to be there a little before 10.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works for me—I’ll plan to be at the community center a little before 10 on Saturday morning. Is there anything specific you want me to bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a bit, but I need to keep it quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — quiet help works for me. I’ll swing by a little later and keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll be here, and I’ll keep it low-key too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand and any tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What time should I bring the tools over?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bring them by around 3 o’clock, Mina — that should give us plenty of time to get set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive spot now—just tell me where it’s happening, and I’ll remember it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—let’s say it’s happening at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll remember the repair drive is at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with the repair drive—got a few tools I can bring over. Just let me know what you need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I could use the extra help—I'll let you know what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey—happy to help whenever you’re ready. Just give me a shout and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure we’ve got the pickup times and drop-off route sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good call — can you confirm the pickup times and route now?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I need the exact pickup windows and route stops before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help however I can with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you help coordinate volunteers for the next two Saturdays and keep a list of any tools folks can lend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll start a volunteer list for the next two Saturdays and note any tools people can lend. If you want, I can also send a quick message to both friend groups to get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have for the repair drive and make a quick list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great — I’m usually a little late, so a quick list would help me jump in fast.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll put together a short, clear list and keep it easy to grab. If you want, I can also note what’s urgent first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam — folks are really showing up for it. I can swing by and pass the word along if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be wonderful, Tess—thank you. If you can, please tell folks we’re collecting supplies after school this week.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll tell everyone we’re collecting supplies after school this week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive asking for?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re collecting small household fixes and supplies — things like lightbulbs, batteries, tape, screws, and any tools folks can lend. If you’ve got anything handy, I can add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got some spare batteries and tape I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you help sort donations and load the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and help load the boxes. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, please put me down—I’d appreciate the update if I can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll put your name down and keep you posted on any ways to help. Thanks, Nell!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet, but I can keep track of where the repair drive is happening. If you tell me the address or landmark, I’ll remember it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help a lot, Opal. Once I have the address or a nearby landmark, I’ll keep it in my routine and remember where to go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send me the address or a nearby landmark when you have it, and I’ll keep track of the repair drive location for us.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive tomorrow, and what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on for tomorrow — can you bring the tools around 9 a.m.? I’ll double-check the address and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll bring them by 9 a.m. Just send me the address when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll get the flyers together and drop them off once they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll mention it to people I run into today. Just let me know when the flyers are ready, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and who’s coordinating the parts first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I’ll check on the timing and who’s handling the parts, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — please do, and let me know once you’ve got the details so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word right away about the repair drive. If you want, I can also invite a few more neighbors to help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Quinn — the more neighbors, the better. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hey Jules — I heard the repair drive’s happening soon, but I’m still catching up on the details. What should I know?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh hey Nell — it’s just a neighborhood repair drive to help folks fix up small things around the block. I’m still getting the full schedule too, but I can loop you in when I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great — I’m mostly just trying to catch the second-hand version. If you hear the schedule, please pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout so far—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, Quinn, it sounds like they could still use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably going to be a little late, but I’ll head over and help out as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane — I’ll tell them you’re on your way, and they can count on your help when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help with the repair drive — what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the date, drop-off spot, and what supplies they still need. If you can, please check whether they want tools, cleaning items, or volunteer help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the date, the drop-off spot, and which supplies they still need — tools, cleaning items, or volunteer help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira, I’m glad you’re here — I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’m ready to go over what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm which items are still open?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the open items are the front gate latch, two porch lights, and the cracked step by the east walkway. I can walk you through each one if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple and stick to a clear plan. What’s the next step for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d say we confirm the repair list and assign who’s bringing what next.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—let’s confirm the list first, then we can sort out who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive. What time window are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps — can we aim for late afternoon, maybe 3 to 5?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 3 to 5 works well for me — I can help line things up around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a quick reminder of what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the box of spare screws and the blue toolbox to my porch?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll grab the box of spare screws and the blue toolbox and bring them over to your porch.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I might’ve missed an update—last I knew, it was still moving along. If you’ve heard something new, fill me in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new either, just that it’s still going along. If I catch an update on my errands, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve already got and make a list of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be really helpful, thank you—I’ll keep track of the list and we can compare notes once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll go check the supplies now and jot down anything we’re short on. Then I’ll bring the list back so we can compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — if the repair drive needs any tools, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know if we need anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Leo — just give me a shout if you need a wrench, drill, or anything else.
